description_en: Issues a file upload URL for an agent session and confirms that the file has been written to the session instance for use in later messages. This operation is available during a canary release. Before calling it, make sure the canary release is enabled for your account and the target region
description_zh: 为 Agent 会话签发文件上传地址，并确认将文件写入会话实例，供后续对话引用。本接口需要开启灰度才可以使用。调用前请确认当前账号及目标地域已开启相应灰度
name: UploadAgentSessionFile

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC protocol version. The example uses 2.0
parameters.help_zh: JSON-RPC 协议版本。示例使用 2.0
parameters.name: jsonrpc

parameters.help_en: The JSON-RPC correlation identifier for the current request. The Id in the response returns this value as is to correlate the request and response
parameters.help_zh: 本次请求的 JSON-RPC 关联标识。响应中的 Id 原样返回该值，便于关联请求与响应
parameters.name: id

fields.help_en: The MD5 hash of the original bytes in 32-character lowercase hexadecimal format. This parameter is required for both prepare and complete, and the values must be consistent
fields.help_zh: 原始字节的 MD5，32 位小写十六进制。prepare 和 complete 均必填，且须保持一致
fields.name: content_md5

fields.help_en: The original file name. The maximum length is 255 bytes in UTF-8 encoding
fields.help_zh: 原始文件名。UTF-8 编码最多 255 字节
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The ID of the target agent session
fields.help_zh: 目标 Agent 会话 ID
fields.name: session_id

fields.help_en: The number of original bytes. Valid values: 1 to 10485760 (10 MiB). This parameter is required for both prepare and complete, and the values must be consistent
fields.help_zh: 原始字节数，范围为 1 至 10485760（10 MiB）。prepare 和 complete 均必填，且须保持一致
fields.name: size

fields.help_en: The upload identifier returned by prepare. This parameter is required when UploadMode is set to complete
fields.help_zh: prepare 返回的上传标识。UploadMode 为 complete 时必填
fields.name: upload_id

fields.help_en: The required upload stage. The prepare step issues a public OSS PUT URL without starting a cold session instance. The complete step resumes the session and allows the runtime to download the file
fields.help_zh: 必填上传阶段。prepare 签发公网 OSS PUT 地址且不启动冷会话实例；complete 恢复会话后由 runtime 下载文件
fields.name: upload_mode

parameters.help_en: The parameter object for the upload stage. The prepare step issues the upload URL, and the complete step confirms that the file has been written to the target session instance
parameters.help_zh: 上传阶段的参数对象。prepare 签发上传地址，complete 确认文件已写入目标会话实例
parameters.name: params

schema.description_en: The request correlation information and the JSON-RPC success result or error object. For public calls, you must also check the outer POP/BFF errors
schema.description_zh: 请求关联信息及 JSON-RPC 成功结果或错误对象。公开调用还须检查 POP/BFF 外层错误

Signature.description_zh: prepare 返回的限时对象存储签名

ExpiresAt.description_en: The expiration time of the current upload signature in ISO 8601 UTC string format. The trailing Z indicates UTC, and fractional seconds may be included. The signature is valid for 5 minutes. Signature expiration does not indicate that the staged object has been deleted
ExpiresAt.description_zh: 本次上传签名的到期时间，使用 ISO 8601 UTC 字符串，末尾 Z 表示 UTC，可能包含小数秒。签名有效期为 5 分钟。签名到期不表示暂存对象被删除

Url.description_en: The complete signed HTTPS PUT URL returned by prepare, which must be used exactly as provided for the upload. The example displayed for this field does not contain a valid signature. The actual request must use the complete signed URL returned by the current prepare call
Url.description_zh: prepare 返回的完整 HTTPS PUT 签名地址，必须原样用于上传。此字段的展示示例不含有效签名，实际请求以本次返回值为准
